subject: Stalled webhook sync — request for sandbox extension & credits
messages:
From: Evan Shaw <evan@bluehaven.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Requesting short sandbox extension — webhook sync failures

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our engineering team: after enabling the webhook-based connector this morning, we started seeing intermittent 504s and dropped event deliveries. Our webhook queue has backed up and the team is focused on root-cause, but it looks like this will push our demo out by at least two weeks.

Given the delay, can we request a 30-day sandbox extension and a temporary bump in tokens (or sandbox credits) so our engineers can continue testing without the POC window expiring? We expected to finish the integration this week but the sync behavior is blocking us.

I can share logs and a short timeline — attaching the initial error dump. Appreciate any help — we love Redwood's performance once the pipeline is stable.

Thanks,
Evan

Team — forwarding BlueHaven. They hit a webhook delivery failure that is blocking their demo and risk us losing momentum on BH-2026-8792. Evan is asking for a 30-day sandbox extension + extra credits.

Quick asks:
- David: can you triage the log and confirm whether this is a config issue on our side or theirs? ETA?
- Ben / Kim: authorize a short runway extension if tech confirms this is an integration hiccup (not feature gap).

I want to keep this lightweight — if we can provide a controlled extension and a token bump now, we should keep the deal warm. I will loop Evan back with next steps.

Thanks,
Naomi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T13:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Requesting short sandbox extension — webhook sync failures

Naomi / Team — I looked through the attached dump (thanks Evan) and ran a quick replay against our dev webhook endpoint. Observations: 

- Error pattern: repeated 504s from the BlueHaven ingress load balancer; Redwood's retry behavior is working, but their LB is returning connection resets mid-handshake.
- Root cause likelihood: misconfigured health checks and aggressive connection timeout on BlueHaven's side. Not seeing evidence of token consumption spike or throttling from our runtime.
- Short-term mitigation: suggest they increase their webhook timeout to 30s and switch to keep-alive connections. We can add a temporary increased retry window for this customer to reduce queue pressure.
- ETA: I can push a per-customer retry window change and monitor within 24 hours, but we need confirmation from BH while they update LB settings.

If we can provide a 30-day sandbox extension and a modest credit bump, that will buy them the time to fix infra. Otherwise they'll lapse and we risk a stalled close.

I'll standby for the approval to flip the temporary retry window.

—David
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Evan Shaw <evan@bluehaven.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@bluehaven.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Requesting short sandbox extension — webhook sync failures

Evan / Lena — thanks for the details and for the logs. We dug in and David confirmed it's likely an ingress timeout on your side. Good news: we can provide a targeted, conditional extension.

What Redwood will provide today:
- 30 calendar days sandbox extension starting 2026-11-19
- 150,000 token sandbox credit allocation (dev/testing only)
- A temporary per-customer retry window and increased queue limit while you correct the LB timeout (we'll revert once monitoring shows stability)

Conditions / next steps:
1) Please update your LB timeout to 30s and enable keep-alive by EOD Friday (2026-11-21).
2) Share a short confirmation email when done. We'll begin monitoring and lift the retry guardrails once stable for 48 hours.
3) Because this is an out-of-band concession, legal wants a short signature on the Sandbox Extension Approval (one-page). I've attached the PDF for e-signature; simple acceptance is fine.

Attachment: sandbox_extension_approval.pdf

If you prefer, Naomi or I can hop on a quick 20-minute troubleshooting call with your infra lead to walk through the LB changes.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back on the demo track.
Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Ben / Naomi — really appreciate the quick response and the grace window. Lena and I signed the PDF and uploaded it to the link you provided (see HubSpot). Our infra team is already applying the keep-alive/timeouts; I attached a short integration summary after the change — we'll confirm stability tomorrow morning.

Thanks for the offer of a quick call; I think we're good but I may take you up on the 20m if the metrics don't settle.

Best,
Evan
